_comment: The ONLY hand-written part of the app store. Everything an APK already knows -- package name,
versionCode, default display name -- is read from the APK itself by tools/build_store.py, so it
cannot be typed wrong here. To publish an app: upload its APK to the 'apps' release. That is all.
Add an entry below only to give it a description/category (or to override the name, or hide it).
Unknown packages default to category 'Tools' with no description. A typo in this file cannot
break the store: the generator rewrites store.json, and CI rejects a manifest that does not parse.

apps.name: microG (native Maps 1/4)
apps.desc: Native Google services. Needs the system signature patch to work - install all 4 microG apps, see notes.

apps.name: microG Companion (native Maps 4/4)
apps.desc: Play Store companion for microG (account sign-in / app updates).
